audit_items.proof_trace: The lower bound guard checks only `refundPeriodSeconds == 0` (rejects 0, allows 1–3599 seconds), failing to enforce the required 1-hour minimum (3600s). All sibling sale contracts enforce `< 1 hours → revert` via `LegionAbstractSale._verifyValidConfig:798`, but `LegionCapitalRaise._verifyValidConfig` omits this check — a consistent omission confirmed by the absence of any `1 hours - 1` boundary test for the capital raise contract. Upper bound (`> 2 weeks`) is correctly enforced.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A deployer (or misconfigured factory deployment) sets `refundPeriodSeconds = 1` during `initialize()`; the guard passes, setting `refundEndTime = block.timestamp + 1`, giving investors a 1-second window to refund — effectively nullifying the investor refund protection.
